How can architects work with communities to support social and ecological justice? Dr Andy Belfield, co-director of public works and Architecture Agency Fellow at the University of Sheffield, explores a place-centred approach to design. Drawing on two public works projects, R-Urban and LJ Works, he examines how collaboration with urban neighbourhoods can support citizen-driven development and the wider commons movement.

network.stated_total_quote: Erasmus+ has powered student mobility across Europe for thirty-five years. Over three million students have already used it to study, teach, train, and live in another European country. Whitecliffe Berlin has been an Erasmus Charter holder since 2015; now our network now spans 27 partner universities across Europe.
